items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: because I used to see his father

ctx.x: And Darnell and Albert Nicholas stayed over there, oh, about two years or more, and they seemed to have enjoyed it, every bit of it, because I used to see his father. His father came to New York when I was there -- Albert's father -- and every time he got a letter from Albert, Albert was telling him how great they were doing and how much money and everything and had more diamond rings and all that sort of business. And when he came back to the states he didn't have a quarter, and that was really funny.
Could we put the mike a little closer? (Inaudible.)
